type: exploratory scheduler ablation, separate from preregistered primary20 episodes
motivation: Prefetch0 isolates delayed supply but forces a hold after every chunk; assess overlapping half the executable chunk with next inference. Faster supply need not improve control because observations are taken while prior actions are moving.
comparison: within-model primary prefetch0 vs added prefetch5, all configurations shown; same initial states, not a new holdout
not_rtc: Simple overlapping FIFO, no delay-conditioned inpainting/RTC corrections. Forecast generated from partially executed old chunk may conflict.
selection: Run both models on all5 states irrespective of improvement; do not replace original primary outcome.
